Herb rice balls

Aperitif fingerfood starter
Total: PT1H15M | Active: PT1H15M

Ingredients

Risotto

1 tbsp olive oil
1 shallot, finely chopped
250 g risotto rice
1.5 dl white wine
5 dl vegetable bouillon
80 g grated Parmesan
2 bunch basil, finely chopped
1 egg
salt and pepper to taste

To shape

150 g mozzarella balls, halved

Crumb coating

100 g white flour
2 eggs, beaten
100 g breadcrumbs

To deep-fry

oil
